name: pepper-language
description: Language support for the Pepper language: syntax highlighting, diagnostics, hover, completion, and go-to-definition via pep-lsp.

pepper.lspPath.description: Optional override for the pep-lsp server binary. Empty (default) uses the server bundled with the extension; set a path (e.g. 'target/release/pep-lsp') to use your own build. The server restarts automatically whenever that binary is rebuilt.

pepper.inlayHints.implicitConversions.description: Show the constructor call an [Implicit] conversion inserts, such as Path( ... ) around a String passed where a Path is expected. Editor-wide inlay hints must also be on (editor.inlayHints.enabled).

pepper.inlayHints.parameterNames.description: Show the parameter name before a literal argument passed by position, such as width: before 800 in resize(800, 600). Editor-wide inlay hints must also be on (editor.inlayHints.enabled).

pepper.buildOptions.description: The build options the language server assumes, as the compiler's -D takes them: NAME or NAME=VALUE (for example USE_ZLIB, LOG_LEVEL=2). They decide which [BuildOption] and [Target(BuildOption(...))] code is active.
